title: Praying mantis threat display
author: Quentin Scouflaire
changes: Praying mantis (Mantis religiosa) in its threat display, filmed in Corsica: the dry rustling hiss and ticks it makes as it spreads and rattles its wings at an attacker. Trimmed to 12.98–14.72 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 150 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 2.0 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Audio track of the video. The 150 Hz high-pass removes measured low-frequency background noise; the wing rustles sit between 400 Hz and 5 kHz.
